rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Pattern-recognition LOs need n≥2 instances with contrast.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L5, L7, L9: two Claude Code sessions with contrasting first prompts (capital-of-Italy → pasta/osso-buco/risotto suggestion vs largest-lake-of-Finland → 'salmon, rye bread, meatballs' suggestion), same second prompt ('What should we have for dinner?'), different answer. That is n=2 with contrast, the rule's floor. L7 also runs the paired-scrutiny step the rule wants: 'Take a guess before it runs. What does Claude suggest now?' Maintainer L39 confirms the two-instance floor is deliberate, not undershot: 'Two sessions is the dose (Antti 2026-08-25) ... The fact-vs-fact contrast carries the mechanism; a third example restates it' — a formerly-present third instance (cardiologist role example) was cut because n=2-with-contrast already satisfies the LO.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Progression-with-variations is the spine.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer L37: 'The Context is King demo (stolen from Agents 101, trimmed to two sessions)' — an openly-declared re-showing of a load-bearing demo that already exists as `curriculum/lectures/context-is-king.md` (confirmed by direct read: that file runs the same Italy/Finland two-window demo, near-verbatim wording, plus a third cardiologist window at its own L27). Confirmed by grep that `context-is-king.md` is wired only into Agents 101 (`curriculum/trainings/agents-101/getting-going.md`) and its claude-basics derivative `context-is-king-cb.md`; `the-wizard-move.md` is wired only into AE101 (`curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/getting-going.md`). No module sequence puts both files in front of the same student, so the harm §9b guards against — a SAME student meeting an identical beat twice and skimming it — is structurally absent; this is instead the rule's own carve-out ('a load-bearing model... MAY be re-shown... on purpose', priced as dosage/placement, 'never route it through mood or arc'), which separate-training reuse across distinct buyer segments (curriculum/CLAUDE.md § Scope: builder-leader vs engineer-IC) satisfies by construction. The dosage obligation is actively exercised here, not skipped: this placement trims 3 examples to 2 (cardiologist cut, L39) rather than copying identically. Checked `curriculum/vocabulary.md` for a tracked 'earning point' for this model/term (obligation (a), stale-note correction): no entry exists, so no maintainer note elsewhere is left asserting a now-false earning point. Self-sufficiency (obligation (b)) holds: the body (L1-15) explains the mechanism standalone and never assumes the reader has seen Agents 101's version.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student agency — adults decide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L7: 'Take a guess before it runs. What does Claude suggest now?' is an invitation to predict, not a paced compulsion ('sit N minutes', 'don't scan'). No forced-pacing or opportunity-as-compulsion phrasing appears anywhere in the body (L1-15) or the maintainer block.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Teach principle + technique — default.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L13 states the WHY: 'Context is whatever you tell it. A fact. A role. A preference. A constraint. All of it colors what comes next.' L15 states the HOW: 'The move is loading the right context before the question, not a clever prompt or a slash command you didn't know.' Student leaves with mechanism plus the technique it implies; nothing is invoked as an unexplained black box.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cohort execution is trainer-paced + concurrent, not sequential.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer L34: 'Time: 8 min. 5 min lecture prose + 3 min live two-session demo in Claude Code.' 'Demo watch-fors' (L43-44) names the trainer as the sole actor running the two sessions ('Establish that the sessions are independent before you deliver... Dry-run once before the cohort'); no student runs a concurrent copy of the demo, so the 8-minute budget is a correct trainer-only sum, not a mis-modeled trainer-demo-time-plus-student-execute-time double-count.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Host-skill optional; maintainer blocks trainer-only.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'Demo watch-fors' (L42-44) names the trainer as sole actor throughout — 'read your own user rules before the cohort', 'Dry-run once before the cohort on the Claude Code version the room will meet' — with no host-skill/Nerd reference and no '(trainer in cohort; Nerd in self-study)' dual-actor parenthetical anywhere in the file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Classroom = default delivery; body teaches work, trainer manages room.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L5-L9 narrate the two-session demo in third person; no group/pair/discuss/pause-cue sentence appears anywhere in the body. L7 'Take a guess before it runs' names WORK (the student's own prediction of the mechanism), not cohort management (pacing/comparing/sharing), so it stays on the correct side of §27's diagnostic. No trainer-cue or 'discuss with...' sentence is authored into the body; cohort pacing lives only in the maintainer block's Demo watch-fors, which is out-of-body per the rule.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Maintainer-block hedge naming section's own failure mode = cut-signal, not warning.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L43's 'Salvage if session 2 answers Finnish-adjacent anyway: "It remembered — which is the lecture's point one step early..."' reads as a genuine, actionable recovery move, not a hedge propping up a shaky section premise. Premise-test: remove the salvage clause — is the section still defensible? Yes: the underlying claim (session isolation in an empty directory outside any repo) is independently verified live, not merely asserted — backing block `demo-fires-live` (L60) records 'Verified live 2026-08-23 by opening a session in an empty non-git directory and reading back the user file's first heading.' Removing the salvage line would only drop a useful trainer recovery move, not restore a defensible section from an indefensible one.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Removals are strategic — ask before cutting.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Verified via `git log --oneline -- curriculum/lectures/the-wizard-move.md` and `git show` (not from body content) that the two non-trivial removals inside the pinned diff range are both human-authored commits, not silent generation-step cuts. Commit b1911175 (Author: Antti Tevanlinna, Aug 25, msg: 'The wizard move opens on the demo: audience-qualifier slide and cardiologist third example cut') removed the cardiologist example. Commit 58e8a506 (Author: Antti Tevanlinna, Aug 28, msg: 'A body cut at the end of the body staled nothing...') removed the whole '## The loop is what you repeat' H2 section; the maintainer's current L23 explains the removal as a relocation ('the-machine-you-just-met.md lands it after the four exercises') — verified by grepping that destination file, which does contain '## You just ran the same loop' (L44) and the kicker 'The loop is the shape. The bug today was the excuse.' (L63). Both removals are ask-before-cut compliant by construction: they are the maintainer's own authored commits, not a generation step silently discarding content.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Load-bearing platform feature = no fallback. Gate or redesign.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Backing block `demo-fires-live` (L60): 'Owed before each cohort: two fresh sessions, one directory each, on the Claude Code version the room will use, the dinner question run through, then result:ATTESTED... fallback: none. If the demo stops firing, the opener needs rebuilding, not rewording.' This is the rule's option (a), gate-on-verified-precondition before each cohort, not a diminished 'if it doesn't work, just do Y instead' fallback.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Maintainer blocks point, don't restate. Link architecture doc where they touch delivery.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Checked `curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/training-architecture.md` § Working directory model and § Rule files for a canonical home this file's Demo watch-fors (L43) might be restating. No match: the maintainer note describes a deliberately DIFFERENT setup — an empty directory OUTSIDE any repo, used only to make this one demo's session-isolation claim true — plus the user-scope-vs-project-scope loading distinction (`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` loads everywhere; project files don't), which training-architecture.md does not state anywhere. This is unique, file-specific content the demo depends on, not a restated cross-cutting mechanic, so no pointer is owed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Walk-away test (M2+).
50% magic rule (M3–M8).
Trust the agentic design — no human backstops.
Quality ladder.
One exercise = one bounded activity.
Modules composable across variants.
Three-level completeness.
Delegation — student brings, Claude screens.
Split mega-exercise when phases = distinct skills + distinct artifacts.
Artifact-realism check.
Auto-fire sim+eval after significant rewrite.
Forcing functions stay, scripted reactions go. Forcing functions live in prompts, not body prose.
Corporate infra = nice-to-have, never forcing function.
Personal-first, team promotion via human conversation.
Measure silent failure, not just friction.
Don't pre-set categories before experiment runs.
Verification layers sample DIFFERENT error distributions — not belt-and-braces.
Cheap-before-expensive verification ordering.
Rule in memory without forcing function = worse than no rule.
Short skeptical pushback on "done" = re-verify trigger.
Reflection beats: in-chat over file-write.
Eval = fixed yardstick; thing measured learns.
Reading burden for verification = banned. Claude audits Claude.
Self-report + self-audit charity — verify at artifact, over-flag or fresh-session for critique.
Offered structures need forced-engagement mechanic.
Source-type blindness on ingestion.
Task selection drives outcome → name floor AND ceiling.
Audience tier determines authoring substrate.
Verification machinery needs smoke-test before trust.
Context-loading tiers as staged progression.
Symmetric visible-mechanics > runtime fork when dual-runtime constraints break agentic move.
Eval architecture — partition by evidence source, not criterion count.
Plug points + UX.
Per-exercise leap test — 3 observable Monday outcomes.
Per-phase failure mode + escape hatch.
Heavy fan-out prompts get body recovery callout.
Save belongs with authoring, not loading.
Convenience-driven prompts with known shape-bias → body acknowledgment callout.
Deliberate-antipattern prompts = class-judge exempt, flagged-by-design.
Session widget — placement by learning flow.
Widgets carry semantics, not just emphasis.
Module prose carrying a `**Session**` widget or a `{{prompt:}}` fence is an exercise that has not been extracted.
Exercise lead-in trio — three slots, three tenses.
Finding the point — four moves.
Body prose must not supply an answer its prompt asks for — position is not the test (widened 2026-08-12).
Engineer-audience audit fixes default to body callout, not forcing function.
Multi-session (any new mechanic mid-arc) ships as packaging, not new primitive.
`/clear` = tool, not ceremony.
Inbound links preserve pedagogical beat across reference restructuring.
Scan at the unit the rule names, not convenient larger one.
Verify mechanism before proposing surgery.
Acting on a flagged item — verify before fixing; its prescribed fix is a hypothesis, not an instruction.
Callouts next to prompts: steer, don't pre-empt.
Persistent TODO surfaces stale by default — audit before acting.
Cross-module prerequisite rescue: run it late, never fabricate.
Three-pass build — finish each pass across ALL modules before starting the next.
Group beat ≠ parallel solo work.
The room's output is named as an artefact.
React, don't author.
Pre-built material is a hard prerequisite, stated in the module.
Attribution is stated by a human, recorded verbatim.
Nothing is written over.
Filing is invisible.
Scope-of-sharing is declared before contribution, not after.
A decision beat needs a real constraint.
Group decisions are human, and named as such.
Retrospective = group round, no prompts, trainer silent.
Second-facilitator test.
Name the too-big and too-small room.
Mixed-experience is the default room.
Room beats overrun; name the protected beat.
No mechanical coverage — the trainer guide carries the load.
Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.

todos.note: The Italy/Finland examples in this file (L5, L7) are near-verbatim identical to `curriculum/lectures/context-is-king.md`'s wording, which §9b's carve-out prefers to avoid ('prefer varied instantiation to identical copy') even where reuse itself is licensed. Not blocking — the two trainings target non-overlapping audiences (Agents 101 vs AE101, confirmed disjoint by grep of getting-going.md wiring) so the rule's returning-student harm doesn't apply — but worth a light phrasing pass if Agents-101/AE101 audience overlap ever becomes real.
